_comment: Every model a tier may use, one LiteLLM deployment each. harness/policy/tiers.json points each tier at ids here (`use`, in LiteLLM order); `jig apply --write` renders both into the managed block of home/shared/litellm/config/config.yaml, and litellm-up.sh reads each keyRef into its apiKeyEnv at launch. A new model is one new entry here and its key in 1Password; `dotctl llm use <tier> <id>` switches a tier to it. Decision: harness/rules/decisions/2026-09-27-model-catalog-and-tier-assignment.md.

deepseek-flash.notes: `deepseek/` passes the id straight through to api.deepseek.com. Measured on this repo's bench: 10/10, TTFT 573 ms, 174 tok/s (home/shared/litellm/config/bench/report-mimo-vs-deepseek.md).

deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Same DeepSeek key as deepseek-flash. Bench: 10/10, TTFT 798 ms, 69 tok/s (report-mimo-vs-deepseek-pro.md).

mimo-v2.6-flash.notes: Pay-as-you-go key (sk-). Reasons by default; in a multi-turn tool conversation the previous reasoning_content must be sent back or the API rejects the request (docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/xiaomi_mimo). Tool-call loops are reported widely (rules/research/2026-09-26-mimo-vs-deepseek.md). Bench: 10/10, TTFT 3447 ms, 113 tok/s. Prices per token from the vendor, since the pinned LiteLLM predates V2.6.

mimo-v2.6-pro.notes: Same key and caveats as mimo-v2.6-flash. Bench: 10/10, TTFT 3525 ms, 127 tok/s (report-mimo-vs-deepseek-pro.md).

qwen3.8-27b-linux.notes: The Omarchy desktop's llama-server (RTX 3090 Ti), over the tailnet; the model id is the GGUF file name without .gguf (router mode). Health-checked in the background, so while the desktop is off it is out of the pool; cooldown_time is longer than health_check_interval (docs/proxy/health_check_routing.md).

qwen3.8-27b-mac.notes: The Mac's LM Studio, loaded just in time and unloaded after 600 idle seconds so the Mac's own model comes back (lmstudio.ai/docs/app/api/ttl-and-auto-evict); 15.0 tok/s measured (bench/report.md). Never probed: a probe is a real completion and would keep Qwen loaded.
